## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      5 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 27 июн. 2026 г. - 13 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Vanessalikescake_, 13 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "Every time I do a workout it freezes and goes on a loop without finishing the workout routine. It’s frustrating and causing me to waste a lot of time."
            2. _Beef_Curtains_, 13 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "When i synced it to my google health app it doubled all my steps and there was no fixing it. I tried for hours but its broken. Feels like i lost all my hard-work and data because of a dumb technical glitch."
            3. _SarahCelebrian_, 2 сент. 2026 г., 2/5: "I got a Fastest 5k award for a 3.5km run and according to the award I ran the 5k in 20 minutes which doesn’t match the workout so no idea where it’s coming from. This is annoying because now I can’t see my actual fastest time or when it was. Very disappointing that there’s no easy way to report bugs like this. I’d expected better from Apple"
